## Notes

**Quick read:** Blonde mom of two toddlers who was pregnant with her third in July (her 2.5 year old daughter is about 25 to 26 lbs); clear, informative talking-head explainer with the sizing facts right, plus a lovely Tennessee hike clip. ROAS 1.49 on small spend.
**Best next move:** ask her to resubmit the Sep 10 video (c496d108) inside the V3 program, since it was only rejected for being in the old program, and ask gently whether the new baby has arrived.

### Style (from watching her videos)
- On camera: blonde mom, sometimes in black glasses, grey band tee and bike shorts. Toddler daughter about 2.5 with curly dark hair; she mentions two toddlers and being pregnant with her third (Jul 23); by Sep 10 the script mentions "my youngest baby" who can be "cradled in here", so the baby may have arrived (not confirmed). Settings: her driveway by a white truck, a bathroom, and a mountain trail in Tennessee.
- Format: calm explainer yapper, 54 to 65 seconds, subtitles at the bottom; plus a 5-second text-only back shot. Hooks: text "MY #1 MUST HAVE AS A MOM OF 2 TODDLERS + PREGNANT", "I'm pregnant with my third and let me show you the one baby item I suggest to everyone", text "You're baby/toddler wants held? Try this!" (typo), "This is the sling that I need. I have two other toddlers and everyone wants to be carried", and "Hiked up a mountain in Tennessee, pregnant with my 3rd, all while holding my 2.5 y/o, thanks to this sling".
- What worked: f9d74e16 (driveway explainer) and 78512b7e (hike, "Awesome! We love seeing Bambora helping mamas through their day") approved, 2 ads each. 16 purchases, $864 on $579 spend.
- Rejected: c496d108 (Sep 10, bathroom demo with the empty sling) only because it was submitted to the old program: "could you submit this in the new program you are on". Not resubmitted yet.
- Safety and checklist: one hand is on her daughter in the driveway and hike frames I checked; seat sits under her bottom on the hip. She states "about 10 pounds to start" and "up to 50 pounds" correctly. Her Sep 10 script describes cradling a newborn in the sling, which is not a position in our checklist; worth confirming with Fatima before it runs. The Sep 10 demo has no child in it, and the text hook has a typo ("You're").
- Strengths: trustworthy, factual explainer; sells back relief well ("so you're not... aching your back"); pregnancy plus toddlers is a strong relatable angle.
- To improve: show the sling on a child in every video; if the baby is here, wait for 10 lbs and follow the M position and seat rules.
